site.name: Pandit Bano
site.tagline: Mantras, procedures and kathas for every family occasion
site.description: The complete procedure for every North Indian family samskara, puja, vrat and katha — mantras with meanings, samagri checklists and the pandit's spoken line — in Hindi, English and Bhojpuri. Based on the Shukla Yajurveda (Madhyandina) tradition and the Paraskara Grihya Sutra; sources on every page.
site.lede: A path to becoming a purohit for the learner, the meaning of every rite and a preparation list for the host, and a clean pothi on the phone for the pandit — all in one place, free.

occasion.sutra_meaning: Let them also follow the custom of the village; for it is said: “in marriage and at the cremation ground, enter the village (custom)”; hence in these two the village is the authority.
occasion.sutra_note: The Grihya Sutra itself says that in marriage and funeral rites the village custom is the authority — variants are variants, not corruptions.

home.path_learn_body: Levels 0 to 4: who a purohit is, pronunciation, the grammar of ritual, occasion playbooks, advanced rites. A self-check quiz with every lesson.
home.path_occasions_body: Every family samskara, puja and vrat as a procedure — each step in order with its mantra, meaning, samagri list and the pandit's spoken line.
home.path_texts_body: The ritual mantras of the Shukla Yajurveda, Rudrashtadhyayi, Purusha Sukta, Shri Sukta, Durga Saptashati, Sundarkand — in Devanagari and Roman, with word split and meaning.
home.today_body: See today's panchang, vrats, festivals and marriage muhurat on Shubhvela — in Hindi, English and Bhojpuri.
home.how_body: Every mantra's source (Sanskrit Wikisource, CC BY-SA 4.0) and every procedure's texts are stated on the page. Every statement about results is given as what “tradition holds”, never as fact. The machine voice is approximate — no Vedic svara. No ads, no accounts, no data.

mantras.title: Ritual mantras
mantras.lede: The mantras recited inside the procedures, grouped by source — each in Devanagari (with svara marks where the source has them), Roman script, word split, meaning and ritual use.

svara_legend.title: Svara marks
svara_legend.body: The vertical stroke above ({svarita}) is svarita, the stroke below ({anudatta}) is anudatta; an unmarked syllable is udatta. The candrabindu in ‘{nasal}’ is the Yajurvedic nasal. The machine voice does not reproduce the svara.

occasions.title: Occasions
occasions.lede: The procedure of every family samskara, puja, vrat and katha, in groups — each page with the steps in order, the mantras, the samagri list and the pandit's line.
occasions.empty_group: Pages for this group arrive in a later phase.

texts.title: Mantras and texts
texts.lede: The ritual mantras and the long texts — Rudrashtadhyayi, the suktas, the Sanskrit originals of the kathas — chapter by chapter, every verse in Devanagari, Roman script and with its meaning. Every count is computed from the data.
texts.heading: Texts
texts.mantras_body: The mantras recited inside the procedures, grouped by source.

kathas.title: Kathas
kathas.lede: The Satyanarayan vrat katha and the other kathas heard at home — retold in the site's own words, with the Puranic source and the original verses; each with its puja procedure.

katha.own_words: This retelling is in the site's own words; the original verses are given alongside.

learn.title: Learn
learn.lede: The Pandit Bano path — levels 0 to 4: who a purohit is, pronunciation, the grammar of ritual, occasion playbooks, advanced rites. Every lesson ends with self-check questions; progress is stored in this browser only.
learn.institutions_lede: Institutions offering certificates and diplomas in karmakanda / paurohitya; every name links to its page. Check fees, eligibility and dates there.
learn.checklist_body: This occasion's pothi — actions and mantras only, ready to print.
learn.no_lessons: Lessons for this level arrive in a later phase.
learn.quiz_note: Pick an answer and press “Check”; every option gets feedback.
learn.marks_udatta_how: High, the plain tone; no mark
learn.marks_anudatta_how: Low; a horizontal line under the syllable
learn.marks_svarita_how: Falling from high to low; a vertical line above the syllable
learn.marks_dvisvarita_how: Two vertical lines; more common in southern recitation
learn.marks_anunasika_how: Chandrabindu — a final vowel spoken through the nose
learn.marks_note: The machine voice does not reproduce svara — listen to recognise the marks, not to learn the tones.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.lede: The words of ritual — Hindi, English and Bhojpuri forms, folk forms, a definition and the occasions where each word appears. Only terms defined in all three languages are listed.
glossary.evidence_uncertain: Spelling not yet confirmed — awaiting the owner's review

reference.title: Reference
reference.lede: Panchang basics, muhurat rules, the sankalpa, gotra and pravara, dhyana shlokas, sutak and patak, how this site was verified, and the bibliography. Dates and muhurat are computed on Shubhvela.
